PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://w3id.org/serre/ref#>
SELECT ?zone ?occ ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone ; rdfs:label "Perimeter_bot_ZN_2" .
  ?occ brick:hasLocation ?zone ; a brick:OccupancySensor .
  ?occ ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://w3id.org/serre/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?z WHERE {
  ?z a brick:Zone .
  FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(rdfs:label(?z)), "perim"))
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?cls WHERE { ?p a ?cls . FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?cls)), "occup")) }
SELECT DISTINCT ?cls ?p WHERE { ?p a brick:Occupancy_Sensor . ?p ?p2 ?cls } LIMIT 10
SELECT ?p WHERE { ?p brick:hasLocation ?z . ?z a brick:Zone . FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?z)),"perimeter")) } LIMIT 20
